title: Singing Technique
welcome_lead: Breath, posture and the basics of good singing.
meta_desc: KS3 voice: breathing, posture, warm-ups, head voice.
final_note: Good singing starts with how you breathe.

concepts.def: How you hold your body when singing.
Small wavy pulse in a held note.

walkthroughs.body_html: Singers breathe from the diaphragm, a muscle under the lungs. Put a hand on your belly — it should move out when you breathe in, not your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, shoulders relaxed, head balanced. Good posture lets air flow freely. Slouching squashes your sound.
Chest voice is your normal speaking range — full and resonant. Head voice is higher, lighter — feels like it rings in your head. Pop singers blend both.
